clips.title: Not caring is a superpower
clips.caption: Not caring what other people think about you is a superpower. Jimmy Carr on JRE.
clips.why: Opens on a bold quotable claim, pays off with the Robbie Williams line and Joe's reaction

clips.title: Anxiety vs flow state
clips.caption: Anxiety is thought without control. Flow is control without thought.
clips.why: Memorable definition as the very first line, personal payoff about where his jokes come from

clips.title: Elon will find religion
clips.caption: Fame, fortune, power, pleasure. What happens when you've won all four?
clips.why: Bold prediction opener, clear four-part payoff

clips.title: God or AI
clips.hook: Is he describing God or AI?
clips.caption: All powerful, all knowing, performs miracles and lives in a cloud. God or AI?
clips.why: Riddle structure keeps people watching to the reveal

clips.title: Pyramids and rockets
clips.hook: Pyramids and rockets are the same thing
clips.caption: Huge amounts of human effort to send a chosen few to the heavens.
clips.why: Surprising claim up front, explained in one line
